page.overview:
Who is Gil de Ferran?

Gil de Ferran (11 November 1967 - 29 December 2023) was a French-Brazilian former driver. He tested for the team in 1993, and had a long career in the US with Indy cars, including two series championships and a win in the Indianapolis 500. Since then, he has worked as the sporting director for both the , and the teams. de Ferran also holds the world record for the fastest qualifying lap ever recorded, at 388.541 km/h (241.428 mph), set at California Speedway.
